Write a mixed first-person review of a fictional kitchen timer with a clear display, an annoying beep, and buttons difficult to press with wet hands. Aim for approximately 60–85 English tokens.

message.content: I genuinely appreciate this timer’s crisp, high-contrast display; reading the countdown from across the kitchen is effortless. However, my experience sours quickly during actual use. The buttons are frustratingly stiff, becoming nearly impossible to press when my fingers are wet or greasy from cooking prep. To make matters worse, the alarm emits a shrill, piercing beep that grates on my nerves every single time. It’s a functional tool with significant ergonomic flaws that truly test my patience during busy meal preparations.
